name: tool_workflow
description: Linear chain with a Tool node: START → fetch_data (tool) → summarize (agent). The tool node is a pipeline step that emits a structured Article the agent consumes as input; the agent separately calls `count_sentences`, an agent-callable tool from the library (ADR-0059), to check its own answer.

tools.name: count_sentences
tools.description: Count the sentences in a piece of text (split on '.', '!' and '?').
tools.body:
import re

return len([part for part in re.split(r"[.!?]+", text) if part.strip()])

config.description: Fetch an article from a remote source.

segments.value: Summarize the article in one sentence. Before answering, call the count_sentences tool on your summary and make sure it returns 1.
